eyebrow: ServiceNow DevOps, Testing & Deployment · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 5 · Update Sets at Scale

eyebrow: Batch by feature, not by day or developer
code:
Wrong:                          Right:
"Tuesday's changes"             "New approval workflow"
"Maria's Update Set"            "Redesigned incident form"
(mixes unrelated work)          (one coherent feature, one set)
caption: A day or a name isn't a unit of business value — a feature is.

code:
Update Set A: login tweak
Update Set B: related ACL fix
Update Set C: dependent business rule

Promote in the wrong order -> preview errors or silent breakage
caption: ServiceNow doesn't track or enforce ordering between separate sets.

code:
One Update Set:
  Feature 1 (works)
  Feature 2 (works)
  Feature 3 (BROKEN)

Rollback = roll back everything, including 1 and 2
caption: Welding unrelated features together removes your ability to back out just the broken one.
